# Ahmed Felfel

Ahmed Felfel is a product engineer based in Montréal. He builds learning
products, developer tools, and internal AI systems.

He currently works at Builder.io as a GTM Engineer. He joined as a Customer
Engineer, later worked as a Partner Enablement Engineer, and now works in GTM
engineering. He built software in each role.

## Selected public work

- Builder Academy: Ahmed built it from the start; enablement and content
  teammates contributed later: https://academy.builder.io
- Builder CMS MCP Server: built the initial production implementation:
  https://www.builder.io/c/docs/mcp-builder-server
- Agent Native: open-source contributions across approval flows, meeting capture/history, OAuth, and org role controls:
  https://github.com/BuilderIO/agent-native/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Apaprikaf+is%3Amerged
- Nomad: building for people who live across borders — travel history against visa and tax-day clocks (not legal or tax advice):
  https://github.com/paprikaf/nomad
- @crate.ai/discogs-sdk: creator and maintainer:
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@crate.ai/discogs-sdk
- Galite: early product for organizing meeting notes, decisions, and follow-ups:
  https://galite.ai/

## Published areas of ownership

- Product and UX: turns ambiguous problems into focused products by defining
  the core workflow, cutting scope, and testing the first useful version
- System architecture: sets system boundaries, data flows, and failure modes
  around real constraints, balancing speed, cost, reliability, and room to
  evolve
- Frontend systems: builds polished, accessible interfaces and design systems
  that keep complex workflows clear as products and teams grow
- Backend and cloud systems: designs APIs, data models, and cloud services with
  secure boundaries and clear ownership, balancing reliability, cost, and scale
- AI system design: designs production AI systems around agent orchestration,
  authoritative context, evaluations, human review, and recovery, using MCP
  when it is the right interface
- Delivery and operations: designs the path to production with CI/CD,
  infrastructure as code, observability, and recovery so teams can ship safely
  and diagnose failures quickly
- Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Collège LaSalle, 2016–2019
- Fluent English, French, and Arabic; conversational Spanish
- Based in Montréal, Canada

These profile facts are Ahmed’s own published account:
https://paprikaf.com/resume
